issues.what: the animals hold completely frozen, identical poses for all 6 seconds with no weight shift, head turn, breathing, or step, reading as static models
issues.fix: add natural idle motion, weight shifts, and uncoordinated pauses or steps so each animal reads as alive

issues.where: the large bubble dome in the center of the red pool (frames 6158 to 6161)

issues.fix: break the film from a rupture point and retract the membrane rapidly into droplets and a collapsing rim rather than fading the dome out

issues.where: the red liquid channels, flora, and overcast sky across 0.00 s to 6.00 s

issues.fix: give the liquid ongoing flow and surface motion, add subtle wind sway to the tall flora, and let the cloud layer drift
